events.name: job.schedule_changed.v1

events.name: invoice.sent.v1

events.name: invoice.locked.v1

events.name: conversation.read.v1
events.recovery: Lưu max cursor; sự kiện cũ không làm unread tăng lại

events.name: call.ringing.v1

events.name: call.ended.v1

events.name: wallet.changed.v1

events.name: points.changed.v1
events.recovery: GET /me/points; không cộng delta từ event

events.name: notification.created.v1
events.recovery: GET inbox; kiểm quyền tài nguyên lại khi mở

events.name: notification.read.v1

events.recovery: GET inbox; chỉ phát khi unread chuyển read lần đầu; giữ read_at đơn điệu

events.name: invoice.revision_requested.v1

events.recovery: GET invoice; giữ bản đang nhập và yêu cầu tải lại khi xung đột

events.implementation_scope: P1-06; minimal invalidation, no body, documents, notes or reasons. Current authorization rechecked at delivery.

events.name: review.updated.v1

events.implementation_scope: P1-06; minimal invalidation, no body, documents, notes or reasons. Current authorization rechecked at delivery.

events.name: invoice.receipt_confirmed.v1
events.recovery: GET invoice; never settle from an event

connection.origin: explicit CORS_ORIGIN allowlist for web upgrades; native without Origin still authenticates

controls.access.revoked: {type,id} only for known subscription; clear private state

connection.recovery: listeners before connect; subscribe ACK triggers snapshot; dirty flag reruns events during fetch; event_id bounded dedupe; sequence cursor for messages; no durable per-device replay; connectionStateRecovery disabled
connection.lifecycle: close on token expiry/logout/background, reauthenticate refresh/reconnect; proactive session and membership/assignment revocation after commit; latest ACL under locks immediately before synchronous enqueue
connection.reconciliation: healthy foreground 60s; disconnected HTTP 15s; retry exponential jitter; local tunables, not production SLA

delivery: Outbox + recipient snapshot in same transaction. realtime_deliveries unique(event_id,user_id), lease/retry independent of notifications consumer. Recheck live ACL. Retry same event_id; offline dispatch is not proof of device delivery. Historical events without snapshot are not backfilled; HTTP recovers. Poison isolated after 8 attempts; inspect/retry operationally.

inboxRouting.messages: conversation.* invalidates Conversation.unread; never creates notification inbox entries
inboxRouting.notifications: non-chat events only; notification.read does not modify conversation_reads
inboxRouting.recovery: Authoritative HTTP snapshot across all pages; no event-count arithmetic; independent read and badges

pushPilot.payload: Generic title/body, recipient_id and resource IDs only. No private content.
pushPilot.delivery: Independent persisted device deliveries; recheck session family, current resource permission and settings; revoke DeviceNotRegistered; retry transient failures with bounds. Receipt success means provider handoff, not device receipt. Unknown HTTP results can duplicate alerts; never trigger business mutations from push.
